name: Telegram Bot to Social Media Content Studio (Instagram Drafts & Direct Publish)

parameters.text: =✨ Social Media Content Studio ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ I received your post idea: 💡 "{{ $json.topic }}" How would you like to format this post for Instagram?

=👋 Welcome to Social Media Content Studio ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Transform ideas into publish-ready Instagram posts with AI! 🎙️ Send a Voice Message or 💬 Type any post idea e.g. "Create a post about 3 productivity habits for founders" How it works: 1️⃣ You share an idea (voice or text) 2️⃣ AI designs an aesthetic theme & copy 3️⃣ High-res visual is generated 4️⃣ You review & approve with 1 tap (or request tweaks) 5️⃣ Direct publish to your Instagram feed! 🚀 Send your first idea now to begin!

=🎨 Crafting your content draft... ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ • Topic: {{ $json.topic }} • Format: {{ $json.format === 'carousel' ? '📚 Multi-Slide Carousel' : '🖼️ Single Post' }} AI is currently generating your visual design theme, copywriting, and rendering the high-res graphic. Slides are processed one at a time to keep the server responsive. This may take a few minutes. ⏳

=✍️ Requesting Tweaks & Refinements ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ What changes would you like to make to this draft? Send your feedback as a 💬 text message or 🎙️ voice note! Ideas: • "Make the background darker and more minimalist" • "Shorten the caption and add a stronger call to action" • "Make the colors vibrant neon cyber style"
=🔄 Starting from Zero! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Previous draft has been reset. Send a new idea anytime (text or voice note) and we'll craft fresh content! 🚀
=❌ Draft Discarded ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Your draft was canceled. Whenever you are ready for a new post, just send a message!

buttons.text: ={{ '🚀 Approve & Publish to Instagram (' + ($json.totalSlides > 1 ? ($json.totalSlides + ' Slides') : 'Single Post') + ')' }}

parameters.text: =🚀 Publishing to Instagram... ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Uploading your high-res visual and publishing to your feed. You'll get a confirmation in just a moment! ⏳

=🎉 POST SUCCESSFULLY PUBLISHED TO INSTAGRAM! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ {{ $json.isCarousel ? ('📚 ' + $json.slideCount + '-Slide Carousel Album') : '🖼️ Single Editorial Publication' }} has been successfully published live to your @developmentserhat feed! 🚀 🆔 Media ID: {{ $json.mediaId }} 🔗 Instagram Profile: instagram.com/developmentserhat ⏰ Published At: {{ $json.publishedAt }} Send a new voice note or text anytime to craft your next post! ✨

parameters.text: =⚠️ No Active Draft Found ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Your draft session was cleared because the workflow was reloaded or updated. 💡 What to do: Send your post idea again now to generate a fresh draft!
